remaining_checks.question: SWE Common 3.0 quality schema/semantic claim
remaining_checks.conclusion_or_remaining_question: Supported. OGC 24-014 Clause 8.2.3 declares an optional multi-valued 'quality' attribute of the Clause 8.2.15 union (Quantity, QuantityRange, Category, Text); Clause 7.4.1 allows static or dynamic quality carried by another component. The published AbstractSimpleComponent.json / AbstractDataComponent.json / Quantity.json declare no 'quality' member, and sweCommon.json and these files set no additionalProperties/unevaluatedProperties restriction, so an added 'quality' member is schema-permitted but unvalidated (Requirement 55 is not violated; Abstract Test A.54 cannot detect a malformed one). The Guide Section 4.3 array-of-components interpretation and inline-value rule follow 8.2.3/8.2.15; the local href reference for dynamic quality is a labelled Glaux choice with no standard JSON syntax. No Guide correction; owning leaves 2.1.10 (#36), 2.1.11 (#37), 4.1.5 (#132) unchanged. Planned tests are not executed evidence.

remaining_checks.question: recordsAsArrays and vectorsAsArrays interpretation
remaining_checks.conclusion_or_remaining_question: Supported; register #71 confirmed verbatim. 24-014 Requirement 85A/86A literally say true means JSON objects and 'else' arrays while omitted (default false) means objects, contradicting Clause 8.7.1 (default false = objects), the Clause 10.2.3 introduction (flags switch to arrays), encodings.json ('If true, ... encoded as JSON arrays instead of JSON objects', default false) and Annex B.2.4 (vectorsAsArrays true -> array). The Guide Section 13 'true means arrays' reading is the only one consistent with all other sources; issue #130 tests omitted/false/true and mixed combinations and retains the contradictory wording. Added consequence: Abstract Tests A.85/A.86 test methods check only the JSON-object form, so array-form fixtures are adapted checks against Requirement 85C/86C and must be labelled adapted (related instance recorded under F-08). Optional one-clause addition to Guide Section 13 row 1150; no upstream filing authorized. The singular 'vectorAsArrays' typo in 10.2.3 is confirmed; the schema property is 'vectorsAsArrays'.

remaining_checks.question: Features Part 3/CQL2 identifiers and GeometryCollection minItems
remaining_checks.conclusion_or_remaining_question: Supported. All six Guide Section 7.4 class URIs exist verbatim in the published texts (19-079r2 Clause 2/Annex A: /conf/queryables, /conf/filter; 21-065r2 Clause 2/Annex A: /conf/basic-cql2, /conf/basic-spatial-functions, /conf/basic-spatial-functions-plus, /conf/cql2-json) and the Section 7.4 dependency statements match Clauses 6.1, 7.5, 7.6, 8.3 and 19-079r2 Clause 8.1/Annex A.1. Advertising cql2-json as the only language and the default is conformant under 19-079r2 Requirement 6 B/C (Clause 8.7: no language mandatory; text/JSON SHOULDs belong to the unselected Features Filter class). Section 13 row 1162 confirmed: Annex C.1 and the published cql2.json set geometrycollection.geometries minItems 2 while Clause 7.6.1 prose and the Annex B BNF allow one or more; accepting a singleton exceeds the Requirement 33/38 schema-validity floor and no abstract test exercises it, so it stays a labelled Glaux adaptation (already required by the row and leaf 7.3.3/#231). Test-evidence notes for #229-#232/#228 and Phase 9: A.3.2 evaluates all six comparison operators on Boolean and String queryables (must evaluate, not 400); A.7.1/A.8.1 expect POINT(90 180) to fail (coordinate validation required); dataset-conditional tests A.3.5/A.3.6/A.7.2/A.8.2 are not applicable to an observation server and must be labelled so (F-08 related instance). No Guide correction required.

remaining_checks.question: SensorML 3.0 four referenced class identifiers
remaining_checks.conclusion_or_remaining_question: Supported. OGC 23-000 (published 2025-07-16) base URI http://www.opengis.net/spec/sensorML/3.0 (Clause 6.1) defines /req/json-simple-process (Clause 9.2, /conf/json-simple-process A.12, Requirement 47), /req/json-physical-system (Clause 9.5, /conf/json-physical-system A.15, Requirement 50), /req/json-deployment (Clause 9.6, /conf/json-deployment A.16, Requirement 51) and /req/json-derived-property (Clause 9.7, /conf/json-derived-property A.17, Requirement 52). Published prerequisites: json-physical-system requires /req/json-aggregate-process (A.13) and /req/json-physical-component (A.14); all four rest on /req/json-core (A.11; Requirement 46 media type application/sml+json, matching Guide line 737), whose prerequisite is SWE 3.0 /req/json-block-components. Guide line 255 covers these only generically ('including their applicable dependencies'); optional clarification to name A.11/A.13/A.14 in Section 1.2 or Section 7 so the claim manifest cannot omit them. All JSON-class abstract tests (A.46-A.52) are media-type or schema-validation checks, so the pinned unmodified upstream schemas are the oracle. Editorial residue noted: Clause 9.1.2.1 still carries the draft note recommending application/vnd.ogc.sml+json. No Guide correction required.
